evidence_spans.snippet: The 7-bit device address is 111011x. The 6 MSB bits are fixed.
Connecting SDO to GND results in slave address 1110110 (0x76); connection it to VDDIO results in slave address 1110111 (0x77)
first the register address must be sent in write mode (slave address 111011X0). Then either a stop or a repeated start condition must be generated.
If the value 0xB6 is written to the register, the device is reset using the complete power-on-reset procedure.
The 'id' register contains the chip identification number chip_id[7:0], which is 0x60.
Data readout is done by starting a burst read from 0xF7 to 0xFC (temperature and pressure) or from 0xF7 to 0xFE (temperature, pressure and humidity).
The 8-bit registers are named calib00…calib41 and are stored at memory addresses 0x88…0xA1 and 0xE1…0xE7.
two words must always be combined in order to represent the compensation word.
Automatically set to '1' whenever a conversion is running and back to '0' when the results have been transferred to the data registers.
Controls the rate, filter and interface options of the device. Writes to the 'config' register in normal mode may be ignored.
Time to first communication after both V DD > 1.58 V and V DDIO > 0.65 V
All modes (standard, fast, high speed) are supported. SDA and SCL are not pure open-drain.
